Find [[Pitney]]'s stolen [[Moa Bird]] for him, somewhere in the [[Catacombs]].

==Quest Information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = n
| complete = [[The Worm Problem]]
}}

===Objectives===
* Head to the catacombs and find Pitney's prize bird.
* Return to Pitney for your reward.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Smiting Staff]] [[of Shelter]]
** [[Energy]] +5
** [[Holy Dmg]]: 3-5
** Armor +5 (vs. [[physical damage]])
** Two-handed
* [[Long Sword (crystalline)|Long Sword]]
** [[Slashing Dmg]]: 6-9
** [[Armor rating|Armor]] +5 (while casting)
** Halves casting time of spells (Chance: 5%)

===Environmental changes===
* For the duration of the quest, the [[Corpse]] of [[Prize Moa Bird]] will spawn in the ritual chamber of the catacombs.

==Walkthrough==
After taking the quest, head to [[the Catacombs]]. You can enter from three locations, though Ashford Abbey is probably the quickest.

'''From [[Ashford Abbey]]:''' Head south down one set of stairs, then west down another to a Y-intersection. Take the northwestern path across a bridge and down yet another set of stairs. There are two paths north from this room: a near one which leads to a [[Flame Geyser]], and a less obvious one on the far side of the room. Take the far one, then turn southwest after the second pillar. [[Deadly Crypt Spider]]s pop up along this section. Continue along this path until just before the walls change over to stone blocks, and you'll find a passage south. This passage leads to an intersection with a corridor with groups of undead. Continue south up one set of stairs and down another to find the Corpse of [[Prize Moa Bird]].

'''From [[Green Hills County]]:''' Move past the [[Gargoyle]]s and take the path south, turning west at the intersection. In the large circular room, head southwest and take the corridor south where [[Oberan the Reviled]] stands. After the corridor turns east, [[Deadly Crypt Spider]]s will start popping up. Where the stone wall on your right ends, take path south, and you'll come to an intersection with a corridor with groups of undead. Continue south up one set of stairs and down another to find the Corpse of [[Prize Moa Bird]].

'''From [[Wizard's Folly]]:''' Simply follow the left wall to the northwest and you will enter a corridor with groups of undead. After two or three groups, you'll come to an intersection with corridors north, south, east (the way you came), and west. Turn south and head up one set of stairs and down another to find the Corpse of [[Prize Moa Bird]].

Approach the corpse to complete the quest. Be aware that two [[Crypt Fiend]]s spawn when you get near the corpse. It is usually possible to complete the quest without spawning the Crypt Fiends. Return to [[Pitney]] for your reward.

===Skill recommendations===
* Skills that deal [[Holy Damage]], such as [[Bane Signet]] will help you get rid of the undead along the way quickly.
* The Crypt Fiends are susceptible to [[Fire Damage]], so even a low level character with a spell like [[Flare]] should have an easy time dealing with them.
* The Corpse of the Prize Moa Bird can be used to [[Animate Bone Horror]]s to assist against the fiends.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Pitney
:''"I'm at a loss. First those worms, and now someone has stolen my prize '''moa bird'''. To make matters worse, the tracks seem to indicate that whoever took her led off to the '''Catacombs'''! I don't have to tell you how dangerous it is down there.''

:''But wait, you're a strong <Primary profession>. Would you be willing to find my poor bird and bring her back?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll find your bird.
| decline = I have more important things to do.
| ask = Please find my '''moa bird'''! She'll not last long in those catacombs.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Pitney
:''"My precious bird is dead? And part of some kind of ritual you say? Just my luck.... Well at least nothing worse can happen to me today. In any case, thank you for your trouble."''

==Trivia==
*Pitney's sentence "at least nothing worse can happen to me today" is unfortunate, since the [[Searing]] will happen on the same day.
